name: kronael
description: Sync bridge for the Kronael Claude Code toolkit.

interface.shortDescription: Sync the Kronael Claude Code toolkit from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Runs the canonical sync, deploys the Claude Code bundle into ~/.claude/, and exposes installed skills and lifecycle hooks to Codex through ~/.agents/skills and ~/.codex/hooks.json.
defaultPrompt: Use $kronael-sync to bridge CLAUDE.md, .claude/skills, and hooks into Codex.
